detail.title: When Small Parts Start Thinking Together
detail.lede: We often look for 'leaders' or 'central commands' to explain complex systems. But what if the secret to complexity isn't a master plan, but the curiosity of the individual parts?
detail.reason: Reflecting on the completion of the emergence project and translating the core insight about curiosity as a decentralized driver.
